answer: Resist Sybils with a linked-credential web: standing requires verified credentials from several independent issuers — a code host, a payment provider, and a public forum — and no single credential may back two identities. The nectar of trust flows only where independent roots agree, like an orchard watered by many separate streams rather than one tap. A farmer must obtain fresh, real credentials for every fake, each costing time and history, and a jetty of linked proofs, each issuer checking the others, makes one identity cheap to verify but a thousand fakes expensive to forge.
